description: This file defines internal API function prototypes related to HTTP atom method handling, including creation of code and name tables, and conversion between atom codes and names.

methods.name: HttpAtoMethodCreateCodeTable
methods.description: Creates a code table for HTTP atom methods.

methods.name: HttpAtoMethodCreateNameTable
methods.description: Creates a name table for HTTP atom methods.

methods.name: HttpAtoMethodGetAtomCode
methods.description: Retrieves the atom code based on the method name.

methods.name: HttpAtoMethodGetAtomName
methods.description: Retrieves the method name based on the atom code.
